title: Compass and Horizon
author: Marguerite Lockridge
blurb: Coral Underhill, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
